scope: Promote and independently check the historical MS(3) lower witness; this does not replay the finite-abelian-group SAT grid.

artifact.origin: Author research preserved before workspace consolidation; byte-for-byte promotion.

upper_bound: For N >= 2^14, a three-coloring restricts to 2^1,...,2^14. Since the classical Schur number S(3)=13, a monochromatic exponent triple i+j=k yields a monochromatic product triple. This is the written upper-bound argument of the June 10 archived manuscript, not new research here.
limitations: No fresh replay of the full S(G,k) SAT grid or historical solver certificates.
No human peer review, formal verification, or new novelty assessment.
